description_candidate: Latest Instructions: NEW Important Notice - "This is the final extension for the “On My Own Admission” portal, which will remain open from 22.09.2026 to 12.10.2026, providing a final opportunity for eligible students to complete their applications. No further extension will be granted beyond this date." Important Notice - "For AY 2026–27, the Second Phase of Fresh Application Registration under the SSSJKL Scheme on the NSP Portal is not yet open. Students are advised not to register under any other/incorrect scheme. Once the registration opens, the information will be shared with the eligible students and Institute Nodal Officers through email. Please wait for further instructions". The HSC Round 3 seat allocation result has been published on the student portal on 25th September 2026. Students are advised to log in to the Student Portal and freeze their allotted seats immediately. The HSC Round 3 seat allocation result has been published on the student portal on 25th September 2026. Students are advised to log in to the Student Portal and freeze their allotted seats immediately. INFORMATION FOR ON MY OWN CATEGORY STUDENTS ACADEMIC YEAR 2026–27. The SSSJKL Third Round Choice-Filling for Counselling 2026–27 for HSC (10+2) students is now open from 21st September 2026 to 23rd September 2026. The 3rd Round is being conducted only for General (excluding Delhi University courses), Nursing, Pharmacy, Agriculture, and Physiotherapy courses.Candidates are advised to review and update their choices accordingly. Calendar of Events for Round 3 (excluding Engineering and Technology) – HSC Student Revised Calendar of Events - HSC (10+2) for AY 2026-27 Revised Calendar of Events - Diploma for AY 2026-27 Important Notice - For HSC Students:- The HSC Round 2 seat allocation result has been published on the student portal on 31st August 2026. Students are advised to log in to the Student Portal and freeze their allotted seats immediately. Important Notice – For Diploma Students: The Diploma Round 2 seat allocation result has been published on the Student Portal on 31st August 2026. Students are advised to log in to the Student Portal and freeze their allotted seats immediately. The SSSJKL Second Round Choice-Filling for Counselling 2026–27 for HSC (10+2) and Diploma students is now open from 26 August 2026 to 28 August 2026. Candidates are advised to review and update their choices accordingly. IMPORTANT NOTICE TO ALL PM-USPY (SSSJKL) STUDENTS - It has come to the notice of AICTE that some fake email IDs, social media groups, and individuals are sending emails/messages regarding SSSJKL Counselling and claiming to provide admission-related assistance/Second round counselling. Students are hereby informed that AICTE/SSSJKL does not ask/charge any payment, fee, or amount .If you receive any such messages through emails, WhatsApp groups, or any other channels, Students are strongly advised not to entertain, respond to, or share personal information with such fraudulent emails/messages. For all official information and counselling updates, please visit the official SSSJKL/AICTE portal only. Important Notice – For Delhi University Students: The seat allocation result has been published on the Student Portal on 20 August 2026. Students are advised to log in to the portal and follow the procedure for seat acceptance and reporting. Important Notice – For Sports Category Students: The seat allocation result has been published on the Student Portal on 20 August 2026. Students are advised to log in to the portal and follow the procedure for seat acceptance and reporting. Important Notice - For HSC Students :- "As a special consideration Students are required to report to their allotted institutes and upload the joining report on or before 21st August 2026". Important Notice - For Diploma Students:- "As a special consideration Students are required to report to their allotted institutes and upload the joining report on or before 20th August 2026". For HSC Students:- The HSC seat allocation result has been published on the student portal on 17 August 2026. Students are advised to log in and freeze their allotted seats immediately. For Diploma Students:- The diploma seat allocation result has been published on the student portal on 14 August 2026. Students are advised to log in and freeze their allotted seats immediately. For HSC Students:- Revised calendar for Seat Allotment and reporting to the allotted institute will be updated shortly on the SSSJKL Portal. For Diploma Students:- Revised calendar for reporting to the allotted institute will be updated shortly on the SSSJKL Portal. Notice for HSC & Diploma Students: The Merit List has been published on the SSSJKL Portal on 12 August 2026. Please log in and check your Merit Rank. The SSSJKL Choice Filling Counselling 2026–27 for HSC (10+2) students has been extended to August 3, 2026. Revised list of Nursing Colleges for the Academic Year 2026-27 is now available for choice filling. Candidates are advised to review and update their choices accordingly The Diploma (Lateral Entry) document re-verification (correction window) for SSSJKL counselling 2026–27 is now open from August 1st to August 2nd, 2026. Candidates can make any necessary corrections during this period The HSC document re-verification (correction window) for SSSJKL counselling 2026–27 is now open from July 31st to August 1st, 2026. Candidates can make any necessary corrections during this period IMPORTANT NOTICE: Important instructions for PM-USPY (SSSJKL) candidates seeking admission to the University of Delhi through CSAS (UG)-2026. The mid-entry window portal is now live on the Delhi University portal Important Instructions for PM-USPY (SSSJKL) Candidates Seeking Admission to the University of Delhi IMPORTANT NOTICE: Final extension for Registration and Application Submission for HSC and Diploma students under PMSSS AY 2026-27. Students are advised to complete and submit their applications within the prescribed timeline. No further extension will be entertained under any circumstances. SSSJKL Choice Filling process for Counseling 2026–27 for Diploma (Lateral Entry) students is now open from 24th July to 3rd August 2026. Document verification for Diploma (Lateral Entry) starts from 20th July 2026 at the Facilitation-cum-Document Verification Centres (FDVC). All students must verify their documents on or before 30th July 2026. Document verification has started at Facilitation-cum-Document Verification Centers (FDVC). All the registered students are advised to get their documents verified as soon as possible. List of Facilitation cum Document Verification Center of JAMMU Division List of Facilitation cum Document Verification Center of KASHMIR Division List of Facilitation cum Document Verification Center of LADAKH Division Advertisement for PM-USP SSSJKL Student 2026-27 (English) For Any Queries login to https://css.aicte-india.org/login

source_sections.heading: Page content
source_sections.text: Students who are already availing benefit of any other scholarship scheme including the ones on-boarded National Scholarship Portal are not eligible under Special Scholarship Scheme for the UTs of J&K and Ladakh. For students found applying for or availing any other scholarship during the entire period of SSSJK&L, AICTE shall be free to forfeit their scholarship, admission and take any other administrative and legal action as deemed fit. Students who are already availing benefit of any other scholarship scheme including the ones on-boarded National Scholarship Portal are not eligible under Special Scholarship Scheme for the UTs of J&K and Ladakh.
